title: Later run in a job lane observes an earlier run's key
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He configures JobLane `assets.generate`, publishes `asset_urls` on an early run, then from a later run in the same lane observes `latest` and reads the published artifact URL. Same-lane lineage is allowed by default (JL-07).
implementation: `JobLaneBroker` in `mechaharness.job_lane_broker`; product verbs `lane_publish` / `lane_observe` in `cli_policy_verbs`; story Config binds via `environment.job_lanes` and step `lane` / `run_id` (JL-01..10).
